events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on this day in 1940 in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... celebrating the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, 'The Beatles', commonly known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed their sprawling masterpiece, the 'White Album'. Double album, double the genius. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to rock the world. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A true game-changer! On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', marking a pivotal moment in their sound. Which track still resonates with you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this solemn day, we remember John Lennon, who was taken from us 46 years ago. His music and message of peace live on forever.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary innovator David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie 80
angles.copy: Eighty years since a Starman was born. Celebrating the enduring artistry and influence of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: Long live The King! Remembering Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. His music still moves generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The architect of so many legendary riffs. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin song?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Day
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! Still rocking and still got that soulful rasp. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs' Nutty Birthday
angles.copy: One step beyond... and 66 years young! Happy Birthday to Suggs from Madness. What's your favourite track from the Nutty Boys?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' singer, Paul Young, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the voice behind so many 80s classics, Paul Young! What's your favourite blue-eyed soul hit from him?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly
angles.copy: Pour yourself a cup of ambition! Happy 81st birthday to the incredible Dolly Parton. A true living legend. What's your favourite Dolly song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gazza
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting maestro. What's your favourite Gary-penned hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday! What's your favourite hit from the soul superstar?

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry and James Brown.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: Twenty-eight years ago today, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who was your favourite of the inaugural class?
